patterns.note: An asymmetrical grid layout is used for image galleries, often featuring large, high-quality photographs of interiors and design pieces with generous whitespace.
Large, bold sans-serif headings introduce major sections, providing strong visual hierarchy against smaller, clean sans-serif body text and uppercase labels.

The primary color scheme is stark black and white, with warmth and depth introduced almost exclusively through the natural tones (beiges, browns, creams, wood) present in the high-quality photography of design objects and interiors.

The hero section features large, abstract black shapes that animate and transform as the user scrolls, dynamically revealing the 'UDS' brand name before moving off-screen. Subsequent content sections reveal text and images with subtle fade-in or slide-up effects as they enter the viewport.

Content is organized into distinct sections, often beginning with a large, centered headline, followed by either a grid of images or a structured list of text entries (e.g., media highlights, project descriptions).

technique_notes: The site employs a smooth scrolling library (locomotive-scroll) to create a fluid user experience. The hero animation uses scroll-linked transformations (position, scale, opacity) on large SVG or image elements to dynamically reveal and transition the brand identity. Content sections utilize scroll-triggered reveals, where images and text elements fade or slide into view with a slight delay as they become visible in the viewport, enhancing engagement and visual flow.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold display headings (~3-4x body text) with generous line height, complemented by clean, legible body text and smaller uppercase labels.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp, with most elements and images featuring crisp, right-angled corners.
design_tokens.spacing: Very airy, characterized by expansive negative space around hero elements and section introductions, creating a sense of luxury and focus. Image grids maintain good padding but are more dense.

standout: The site's most distinctive feature is its highly dynamic and abstract hero section, where large graphic elements animate and transform with scroll, creating an interactive reveal of the brand's initials. This sophisticated motion design elevates the brand's presence beyond a static logo, making the initial interaction feel like an art piece itself.
